name: Alibaba Cloud MaxCompute
summary: Run MaxCompute SQL and load Parquet partitions into MaxCompute tables through the Tunnel service. Loads are idempotent by partition and revision (ADR 0012).

fields.name: security_token
fields.label: STS security token
fields.help: Only for temporary credentials from STS.

settings.name: schema
settings.label: Schema
settings.help: Only for projects that use the schema model.

egress.note: service.<region> is the API endpoint and dt.<region> the Tunnel endpoint on the public network. VPC and intranet endpoints are not listed.

operators.summary: Run a MaxCompute SQL job and keep the result as Parquet.
Upload Parquet rows into a table partition with Tunnel, once per partition and revision.

notes: Alibaba Cloud OSS can stage files for external tables (see that connector). Ogun does not create the table or its partition columns.
